corrections.authority: Spec: 'Cumulative means true cumulative — the sum over all prior non-cancelled MBs (the workbook's MB4 row was a confirmed copy-paste error; the corrected wording is authoritative).' The workbook's own MB 5 row already shows the true cumulative 6000/3000, confirming the correction.

corrections.note: Trailing full stops normalised: the workbook ends some now-to-pay clauses without a stop. Spec: 'Punctuation is normalised to a full stop after each clause (the workbook was inconsistent; normalisation confirmed 13/07/2026).' Every expectedRemark below carries the normalised punctuation.

item.note: Uncategorised item whose description does not mention installation -> the final-bill stage applies to 100% of DELIVERED quantity irrespective of installation (spec final-bill stage base; workbook special note 1).

measurementBooks.finalBillBaseNote: Supply-branch item: final % applies to 100% of cumulative DELIVERED quantity (6000), not installed. The final-bill clause renders LAST.

workbookSpecialNotes: For supply items without installation word in the item description, the payment during the final bill will be made 100% of the delivered qty irrescpective of it is installed or not.
For items with supply and installation wording the payment for supply portion only will be done for suplpied but not installed item.
For installation item payment will only be done for installed qty.
